Source.modelVersionSource: Installed botocore service models; native requests used AWS CLI transport.
Source.aws_documentation_revision: AWS live documentation; immutable revision not exposed
Source.transport: scripts/aws/aws_cli.py using explicit official STS/EC2/S3 endpoints; isolated environment discarded local endpoint overrides and environment credentials; account checked before resource operations
Source.redaction: Native account, bucket, resource, client-token, random and canonical-owner identifiers replaced by stable placeholders. Placeholders are scoped independently to each calibration run. No credentials or caller identity retained.

Observations.bucketPolicy: An existing unrelated owner-only GetObject statement was preserved. AWS appended delivery.logs.amazonaws.com PutObject and GetBucketAcl grants with SourceAccount/SourceArn conditions. With no prior policy AWS supplied Id AWSLogDeliveryWrite20150319. An additional Hive custom-prefix destination appended AWSLogDeliveryWrite2 and reused AWSLogDeliveryAclCheck1.
Observations.clientToken: Same token with changed valid TrafficType, aggregation interval, tags or S3 destination bucket/prefix reused the original default-format subscription. A changed log format created another subscription; replaying default format afterward returned only its default-format group. Adding another resource accumulated IDs within the token/format group. Deleted IDs were not retained: replay recreated the deleted resource subscription. Invalid TrafficType and empty ResourceIds were rejected despite an already used token. Fresh token identical configuration failed FlowLogAlreadyExists; fresh token REJECT created a separate subscription. ID order varied between runs.

marker.ACL: Only the canonical owner had FULL_CONTROL.
marker.timing: Default marker already existed at the first list, 3.109 seconds after phase start (which included CreateFlowLogs and GetBucketPolicy). LastModified was in the following wall-clock second after flow CreationTime. This does not establish whether the write preceded the CreateFlowLogs response.
marker.hiveHourlyCustomPrefix: Second-flow experiment: polls through 42.964 seconds observed only the pre-existing default marker. Fresh-bucket comparison then established that a FIRST Hive flow DOES create custom-prefix/AWSLogs/aws-account-id=<ACCOUNT>/, and a FIRST plain-text custom-prefix flow creates custom-prefix/AWSLogs/<ACCOUNT>/. Neither marker includes hour/date/region partitions.

Inferences.statement: Token plus log format is consistent with observed replay grouping across resources. Exact service-internal key and behavior for untested destination types/options are not established. Do not treat this as a generic token-only response cache.

Native zero-byte S3 markers were created without dataplane traffic for first default, first Hive/custom-prefix, and first plain/custom-prefix flows. Precise synchronous/asynchronous response ordering is unproven. A missing second-flow marker in a bucket with a pre-existing marker does not establish that Hive suppresses marker creation.

Cleanup.scope: Every calibration created only exact-owned empty VPCs, private S3 buckets and flow-log subscriptions. No workloads, ENIs, paid compute, generated traffic or existing-resource mutations. Native service-created zero-byte markers were deleted with their owned buckets.
Cleanup.evidence: Each Runs entry retains DeleteFlowLogs results, empty DescribeFlowLogs, successful owned-object/bucket/VPC deletion, bucket HeadBucket 404 and DescribeVpcs InvalidVpcID.NotFound.

Runs.label: first_flow_empty_bucket_hive_and_plain_prefix_markers
Runs.scope: One fresh empty VPC and two fresh private empty buckets. Each bucket received its first flow subscription with custom-prefix. No traffic.
Runs.observation: FIRST flows on empty buckets created markers under their actual custom-prefix and account partition. Hive/hourly used aws-account-id=<ACCOUNT> but no hour/date/region suffix for this marker. This corrects any inference from the previous SECOND-flow experiment that Hive creates no marker.
Runs.inference: Marker existence by first list is observed; whether writing is synchronous with CreateFlowLogs remains unproven. The reason a later flow on a bucket with an existing marker did not create a second marker was not isolated.
